mapper.select:
select mn.*,con.Con_Name AS contractName ,pro.P_Name AS projectName,pro.P_Type as projectType ,comB.C_Name as contractSecondCompanyName from project_acceptance_calculation_audit mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.contract_id=con.Con_Id left join sys_company comB on con.Con_Party_B_Id=comB.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on mn.project_id=pro.P_Id
1=1
and pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.projectName},'%')
and pro.P_Type=#{params.projectType}
and con.Con_Name like concat('%',#{params.contractName},'%')
and comB.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.contractSecondCompanyName},'%')
and mn.status=#{params.status}
order by mn.create_time desc

select mn.*,con.Con_Name AS contractName ,pro.P_Name AS projectName,pro.P_Type as projectType ,comB.C_Name as contractSecondCompanyName from project_acceptance_calculation_audit mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.contract_id=con.Con_Id left join sys_company comB on con.Con_Party_B_Id=comB.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on mn.project_id=pro.P_Id where mn.id=#{id}

select mn.*,con.Con_Name AS contractName,pro.P_Name AS projectName,c.C_Name AS companyName,c2.C_Name AS companyNameJl,zi.name AS indicatorName, zi.type AS indicatorType,pro.P_Construction_Unit as projectConstructionUnit, dep.D_Name AS projectConstructionUnitName,con.Con_Plan_End_Date as conPlanEndDate from znpj_basis_information_quarter mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.contract_id=con.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.project_id left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Company c on c.C_Id=mn.company_id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.company_id_jl left join znpj_indicator zi on mn.indicator_id=zi.id where mn.source_id=#{id} and mn.source_code='ProjectAuditRecordYw'
